subject.title: feat: add SSH lease copy and tunnels

question: Should Crabbox expose both generic resolved-SSH `cp` fallback and a first-class loopback-only `tunnel` command as stable core CLI contracts?
rationale: The patch adds new user-facing command behavior and changes the capability boundary for SSH-capable providers; the linked issues requested the capability but the supplied discussion contains no maintainer confirmation of the permanent core API direction.

options.title: Sponsor the generic SSH transport contract
options.body: Keep the provider-neutral `SSHTarget` approach, require the merge blockers below, and treat `cp` fallback plus loopback tunnels as supported core behavior.

options.title: Limit the scope to file copy
options.body: Land or rework only the SSH copy fallback and leave the new foreground tunnel command for a separately approved API proposal.

options.title: Keep these workflows outside core
options.body: Retain the current provider-native copy boundary and direct users to provider-specific or external SSH tooling instead of expanding the CLI contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the generic SSH transport contract
recommendation.body: Keep the provider-neutral `SSHTarget` approach, require the merge blockers below, and treat `cp` fallback plus loopback tunnels as supported core behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the currently proposed contract and can best provide the implementation rationale, while final product acceptance remains a human maintainer decision.
